title: Abduction phenomenon shatters the Western mind

tellings.quote: the one unforgivable sin to the Western mind is when something that should be in the spirit world transgresses and shows up in the physical world that traffic is the cardinal sin for the Western mind so it has great power to shatter the belief structure of a western mind when that occurs and that's precisely what's occurring in this abduction phenomenon

plain: People's reports of being taken by non-human beings, known as alien abductions, are said to have unusual power because they break the Western mind's deepest rule, that things of the spirit world must not show up in the physical world. The abduction researcher John Mack puts it this way in a clip played on the show: "that traffic is the cardinal sin for the Western mind", so "it has great power to shatter the belief structure of a western mind", and that is "precisely what's occurring in this abduction phenomenon".
